top_verse_en: He was with God in the beginning.

outline.text_en: The divinity, humanity, office, and incarnation of Jesus Christ.
The calling of Simon and Andrew, Philip and Nathanael

parallel_en.text: He was in the beginning with God.
The same was in the beginning with God.
He was with God in the beginning.
He existed in the beginning with God.
The Word was with God in the beginning.
This One himself was at the origin with God.
